You are now strong enough for the Survival Arena. In Giran, next to the Class Master, the Arena Master Pilkins runs it.

For one %medal% you face a single challenger, wave after wave. It grows stronger every wave and enrages if a wave takes too long. Only your own fall ends the run - and dying there costs no experience or buffs.

You are paid %coin%s for the last wave you cleared, with a bonus every few waves. Once you have a record, a quick run trades a medal for your best payout without fighting.

Spend the coins at Dortmund, the Arena Merchant beside him, on crafting materials.
